title: Context Engineering: An Industry-Wide Technical Landscape
summary: A full-stack survey connecting context editing and agent design to inference, model architecture, and compute infrastructure.
body:
## Research scope

This research deck surveys how the AI industry approaches context engineering, from the fundamentals to the infrastructure underneath it.

## Inside the deck

1. Definitions, importance, and challenges of context engineering
2. Industry practice
3. Context editing and agent design
4. Inference methods and model architecture
5. Compute infrastructure and future directions

## Reading context

The original Chinese slide deck was written in October 2025. This introduction summarises its structure; the original document below contains the full research. Historical material reflects its original date.
